reasons: Cited Sections 11.1-11.3 satisfy the rule's preferred position: six months of transition assistance at Order Form rates, return of all Customer Data within 30 days in a commonly used machine-readable format, and secure deletion with written officer certification.
Claimed status is compliant, and consistent with that, no redline or comment is proposed; the rendered paragraphs are unchanged from the originals.

Deterministic check confirms data return/transition language is present; rationale accurately reflects the paragraph text (including no-withholding for fee disputes and law-required retained copy remaining protected).
